verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers a hosted MCP server that lets external AI assistants (e.g., Claude) query events, funnels, retention, and even create dashboards via natural language, and it provides AI-generated summaries for session replay playlists. However, this is not a built-in in-product AI assistant/chat interface for delegating tasks—it relies on connecting third-party AI clients through MCP, which is a narrower, more technical form of delegation.
